CPU was not idle: during the init-only stage comsolbatch.exe (~2.6 cores), bdservicehost.exe (~1.9 cores), SearchIndexer (~1 core) and two Codex sandbox setups were active (87 % of 20 logical cores at 17:56); by the ei run (18:07-18:17) only this interpreter and bdservicehost (~1 core) were active (25 % CPU). The init-only numbers are therefore CPU-confounded by COMSOL; the two 1 ms runs are the clean points.
